trap-negation-contrast.evidence: Full read. trap-nonspeakable.evidence: The kappa sentence is 63 words with a 41-word em-dash interruption between subject and verb: 'The determinant ratio $\kappa = \det G^{cl}/\det G^{q}$ --- of the 2x2 Chern--Simons pairing displayed above, **not** of the 6x6 Markov--Gram tr_M(b_i b_j) of [Frobenius Gram matrix], which is a different matrix and is singular under the production trace convention --- is conjectured to capture the self-dual damping at the J^2 level, with numerical value kappa approx 1.722.' It parses on the page and stalls aloud. Sole instance; severity minor.
trap-nonspeakable.notes: Structural (math-adjacent), not edited. Proposed fix: split into two sentences - 'The determinant ratio $\kappa = \det G^{cl}_{CS}/\det G^{q}_{CS}$ of the $2\times2$ Chern--Simons pairing displayed above is conjectured to capture the self-dual damping at the $J^2$ level, with numerical value $\kappa \approx 1.722$.' then 'This is not the $6\times6$ Markov--Gram $\mathrm{tr}_M(b_i b_j)$ of [Frobenius Gram matrix](#prop:frobenius-gram-matrix), which is a different matrix and is singular under the production trace convention.' Keeps the disambiguation, drops the interruption.
